_note: Central, configurable definition of the WhatsApp agent's price-NEGOTIATION engine (founder-approved spec §3). The database/config is the single source of truth — the ladder, ghost window and concession fraction are NEVER hardcoded across components. This is DISTINCT from config/order_discounts.json (named/automatic promos): negotiation is the ONLY sanctioned way to move off the website baseline, and it fires ONLY when the customer haggles. Percentages are whole numbers (10 = 10%). Amounts are compared per-market against the eligible order subtotal (sum of final, VAT-inclusive line totals). The facility-floor is computed backend-side and only the floor PRICE is ever surfaced — the raw facility cost is never exposed to the agent or the customer (CLAUDE.md §7).
